import re

def parse_nginx_log(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.
    
    Typical nginx log format (combined):
    <ip> - - [<date>] "<method> <url> <protocol>" <status> <size> "<referrer>" "<user-agent>"
    
    Example:
    127.0.0.1 - - [10/Dec/2023:15:30:00 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 1234 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
    """
    # Regex to capture the common nginx combined log format
    pattern = (
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+)\s+'
        r'(?P<user>\S+)\s+'
        r'(?P<ident>\S+)\s+'
        r'\[(?P<date>[^\]]+)\]\s+'
        r'"(?P<method>\S+)\s+(?P<url>[^\"]*)\s+(?P<protocol>[^\"]*)"\s+'
        r'(?P<status>\d+)\s+'
        r'(?P<size>\d+)\s+'
        r'"(?P<referrer>[^\"]*)"\s+'
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^\"]*)"'
    )
    
    match = re.match(pattern, line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse log line: {line}")
    
    return match.groupdict()
